Take a shelter dog (over 6 months and 30+ lbs) out for a few hours, overnight or a weekend; leash, harness and Adopt Me gear provided. Walk in to the foster window in the adoptions lobby Tue-Sun 11am-7pm, or fill out the Foster Field Trip Application and email the dog's name and preferred date/time.
